title: Air ground communication method for transmitting safety messages over non safety infrastructure
cluster: A - Safety / ATS traffic over non-safety or broadband IP links (closest art)
what_it_discloses: Virtual Safety Radio (VSR) exposed to the ACD router (CMU/ATSU) through a cross-router (X-router) interface to AISD/PIESD routers. VSR determines by active and/or passive link probing that a non-safety media link (cellular 5G, cabin SATCOM) is available; a Multi-Link Engine selects the best non-safety media from media status + probe result; messages are secured by cryptography and tagged with metadata; a ground tunnel endpoint / ground gateway decapsulates, verifies and routes to ACARS / ATN-OSI endpoints; if no acknowledgement within a time threshold the VSR reports link failure and the ACD router re-sends over a safety media (HF/VDL/SATCOM). Spec explicitly covers SNDCF frames and A618 blocks over the AISD network, states applicability to ATN/IPS, cites RCP/RSP (DO-350A/ED-228A) and the EASA/FAA Hyperconnected ATM white paper, and notes the ACD router may 'select which kind of ACARS and/or ATN/OSI traffic it will convey via the AISD/PIESD'.
differentiation_hook_for_our_filing: Reactive (ack-timeout) fallback and a single availability determination. No per-traffic-class / per-airspace statistical RCP admission state machine, no shadow dual-cast evidence building, no constellation-aware prediction, no RCP-budget hedge timing, no composite-availability construction from multiple LEO links, no signed on-board evidence record bound to admission decisions.
